spo2-watch.title: Blood oxygen low
spo2-watch.what: Your blood oxygen is {spo2Pct}%, below the normal {setting:spo2.watchBelowPct}%.
spo2-watch.why: A low reading can be a real drop in blood oxygen, or it can come from the watch fitting loosely.
spo2-watch.do: Sit still, tighten the watch, and measure again in 5 minutes.

spo2-alert.title: Blood oxygen very low
spo2-alert.why: Blood oxygen this low means the body may not be getting enough oxygen.
spo2-alert.do: Stop what you are doing and measure again now. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

heart-rate-low-alert.title: Heart rate very low
heart-rate-low-alert.what: Your heart rate is {heartRateBpm} bpm, below {setting:heartRate.alertBelowBpm} bpm.
heart-rate-low-alert.why: A heart rate this low is outside the range this app treats as safe, and it needs a check.
heart-rate-low-alert.do: Take an ECG now. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

heart-rate-high-alert.title: Heart rate very high
heart-rate-high-alert.what: Your heart rate is {heartRateBpm} bpm, above {setting:heartRate.alertAboveBpm} bpm.
heart-rate-high-alert.why: A heart rate this high can happen during very hard exercise; at any other time it needs a check.
heart-rate-high-alert.do: Stop and rest, then take an ECG. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

heart-rate-above-baseline-watch.title: Heart rate above your normal
heart-rate-above-baseline-watch.what: Your heart rate is {heartRateBpm} bpm, {heartRateAboveBaselineSd} standard deviations above your baseline.
heart-rate-above-baseline-watch.why: Your heart rate is well above your usual range. Exercise and other activity raise it; if you have been resting, it is worth a check.

heart-rate-above-baseline-alert.title: Heart rate far above your normal
heart-rate-above-baseline-alert.what: Your heart rate is {heartRateBpm} bpm, {heartRateAboveBaselineSd} standard deviations above your baseline.
heart-rate-above-baseline-alert.why: A heart rate this far above your normal needs a check, unless you are exercising hard.
heart-rate-above-baseline-alert.do: Stop and rest, then take an ECG. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

skin-temp-off-baseline-watch.title: Skin temperature off your normal
skin-temp-off-baseline-watch.what: Your skin temperature is {skinTempAwayFromBaselineSd} standard deviations away from your baseline.
skin-temp-off-baseline-watch.why: Skin temperature changes with the cabin temperature, activity and the watch fit; a lasting change is worth watching.
skin-temp-off-baseline-watch.do: Recheck in 30 minutes, and tell the flight surgeon if you feel unwell.

skin-temp-off-baseline-alert.title: Skin temperature far off your normal
skin-temp-off-baseline-alert.what: Your skin temperature is {skinTempAwayFromBaselineSd} standard deviations away from your baseline.
skin-temp-off-baseline-alert.why: A change this large from your normal needs a check.
skin-temp-off-baseline-alert.do: Rest and recheck now. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

hrv-below-baseline-watch.title: HRV below your normal
hrv-below-baseline-watch.what: Your heart rate variability is {hrvBelowBaselineSd} standard deviations below your baseline.
hrv-below-baseline-watch.why: Your HRV is lower than usual for you. Sleep loss and heavy workloads are common stressors in spaceflight.
hrv-below-baseline-watch.do: Take a short break, and aim for a full sleep period tonight.

hrv-below-baseline-alert.title: HRV far below your normal
hrv-below-baseline-alert.what: Your heart rate variability is {hrvBelowBaselineSd} standard deviations below your baseline.
hrv-below-baseline-alert.why: HRV this far below your normal needs a check.
hrv-below-baseline-alert.do: Rest now. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

radiation-solar-event-watch.title: Radiation dose rising
radiation-solar-event-watch.what: The ship's radiation dose over the last 24 hours is {radiationDailyDoseMultiple}× the average of the 7 days before ({radiationDailyDoseUGy} vs. {radiationPreviousAverageUGy} µGy).
radiation-solar-event-watch.why: A rise like this can be the start of a solar particle event. NASA limits a solar event's dose to under 250 mSv [V1 4031].
radiation-solar-event-watch.do: No action is needed yet. Watch for an alert, and follow your crew's radiation plan if one comes.

radiation-solar-event-alert.title: Radiation dose spike
radiation-solar-event-alert.what: The ship's radiation dose over the last 24 hours is {radiationDailyDoseMultiple}× the average of the 7 days before ({radiationDailyDoseUGy} vs. {radiationPreviousAverageUGy} µGy). This applies to the whole crew.
radiation-solar-event-alert.why: A rise this large can be a sign of a solar particle event. NASA requires the crew and operations teams to be alerted when exposure rates exceed set thresholds [V2 6164].
radiation-solar-event-alert.do: Follow your mission's planned radiation sheltering steps and any instructions from the ground. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

radiation-career-watch.title: Career radiation dose high
radiation-career-watch.what: Your career radiation dose equivalent (estimate) is {radiationCareerDoseMSv} mSv, {radiationCareerPercentOfLimit}% of NASA's {setting:radiation.careerLimitMSv} mSv career limit (from the ship's sensor this mission).
radiation-career-watch.why: Career dose adds up over every mission and raises long-term cancer risk. NASA caps it at {setting:radiation.careerLimitMSv} mSv for all ages and sexes [V1 4030].
radiation-career-watch.do: Talk with the flight surgeon about limiting further exposure on this mission.

radiation-career-alert.title: Career radiation limit projected
radiation-career-alert.what: At the average dose rate so far, your career radiation dose equivalent (estimate) is projected to reach NASA's {setting:radiation.careerLimitMSv} mSv limit by the end of the {setting:mission.plannedLengthDays}-day mission.
radiation-career-alert.why: NASA caps career effective dose at {setting:radiation.careerLimitMSv} mSv [V1 4030].
radiation-career-alert.do: An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon. Talk with them about your exposure.

gravity-exercise-goal-met.title: Exercise goal met
gravity-exercise-goal-met.what: You have {exerciseMinutesToday} exercise minutes today, meeting the {setting:exercise.dailyGoalMinutes}-minute daily goal.
gravity-exercise-goal-met.why: Daily exercise protects bones and muscles in microgravity.

gravity-exercise-watch.title: Exercise behind pace
gravity-exercise-watch.what: You have {exerciseMinutesToday} exercise minutes today, under {setting:gravity.exerciseWatchBelowMinutes} this late in the day.
gravity-exercise-watch.why: Without gravity, bones and muscles weaken; all astronauts exercise during their missions to counter this.
gravity-exercise-watch.do: Fit in an exercise session before your sleep period.

co2-one-hour-alert.title: CO₂ above limit
co2-one-hour-alert.what: Cabin CO₂ averaged {co2OneHourAverageMmHg} mmHg over the last hour, above NASA's {setting:co2.oneHourAlertAboveMmHg} mmHg limit.
co2-one-hour-alert.why: Without enough airflow, CO₂ can collect in pockets, and higher CO₂ is linked to headaches in crews.
co2-one-hour-alert.do: Tell the crew so CO₂ removal can be checked, and tell the flight surgeon if you get a headache. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

co2-one-hour-watch.title: CO₂ near limit
co2-one-hour-watch.what: Cabin CO₂ averaged {co2OneHourAverageMmHg} mmHg over the last hour, close to NASA's {setting:co2.oneHourAlertAboveMmHg} mmHg limit.
co2-one-hour-watch.why: NASA guidance links a 7-day average below {setting:co2.sevenDayWatchFromMmHg} mmHg to headache risk under 1%; this hour is above that level.
co2-one-hour-watch.do: Tell the crew if you get a headache, and recheck in an hour.

co2-seven-day-watch.title: CO₂ high this week
co2-seven-day-watch.what: Cabin CO₂ has averaged {co2SevenDayAverageMmHg} mmHg over the last 7 days.
co2-seven-day-watch.why: NASA advises a 7-day average below {setting:co2.sevenDayWatchFromMmHg} mmHg to hold headache risk under 1%.
co2-seven-day-watch.do: Report the trend to the crew so CO₂ removal can be checked.

pressure-low-alert.title: Cabin pressure too low
pressure-low-alert.what: Cabin pressure at your watch reads {pressureKPa} kPa, at or below NASA's {setting:pressure.minExclusiveKPa} kPa minimum.
pressure-low-alert.why: Pressure this low risks hypoxia and decompression sickness.
pressure-low-alert.do: Check the ship's own cabin pressure display and tell the crew right away. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

pressure-high-alert.title: Cabin pressure too high
pressure-high-alert.what: Cabin pressure at your watch reads {pressureKPa} kPa, above NASA's {setting:pressure.maxKPa} kPa maximum.
pressure-high-alert.why: NASA sets {setting:pressure.maxKPa} kPa as the upper limit for indefinite exposure [V2 6006].
pressure-high-alert.do: Report it to the crew so the pressure can be checked. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

pressure-shift-watch.title: Cabin pressure shift
pressure-shift-watch.what: Cabin pressure at your watch reads {pressureKPa} kPa, {pressureShiftKPa} kPa away from its average over the last 24 hours.
pressure-shift-watch.why: A shift like this can come from a real change in cabin pressure or from the watch sensor.
pressure-shift-watch.do: Recheck in a few minutes and report it to the crew if it holds.

cabin-comfort-zone-watch.title: Cabin air outside comfort zone
cabin-comfort-zone-watch.what: Cabin air is {cabinTempC} °C at {cabinHumidityPct}% humidity, outside NASA's temperature and humidity zone.
cabin-comfort-zone-watch.why: NASA limits temperature and humidity together; outside the zone crews can have dry or irritated airways, rashes, thermal discomfort or lower performance [V2 6012].
cabin-comfort-zone-watch.do: Tell the crew so the cabin air can be checked, and tell the flight surgeon if you feel unwell.

cabin-comfort-zone-alert.title: Cabin air far outside comfort zone
cabin-comfort-zone-alert.what: Cabin air is {cabinTempC} °C at {cabinHumidityPct}% humidity, more than {setting:cabinZone.alertMarginC} °C or {setting:cabinZone.alertMarginRhPct}% humidity outside NASA's zone.
cabin-comfort-zone-alert.why: Far outside the zone, thermal discomfort and lower performance are more likely [V2 6012].
cabin-comfort-zone-alert.do: Report it to the crew so the cabin air can be fixed. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

noise-sleep-watch.title: Noisy sleep period
noise-sleep-watch.what: Noise during the sleep period averaged {noiseSleepLevelDba} dBA, above the {setting:noise.sleepWatchAboveDba} dBA sleep limit.
noise-sleep-watch.why: Noise above this level can disturb sleep; an ISS flight rule sets sleep stations at {setting:noise.sleepWatchAboveDba} dBA or below.
noise-sleep-watch.do: Close your crew quarters and use earplugs; report loud equipment.

noise-awake-watch.title: Noisy work area
noise-awake-watch.what: Noise while awake averaged {noiseAwakeLevelDba} dBA, above {setting:noise.awakeWatchAboveDba} dBA, our rough dBA stand-in for NASA's NC-50 work-area limit.
noise-awake-watch.why: Constant noise can make it harder to talk and work, and can cause irritation and headaches.
noise-awake-watch.do: Wear hearing protection near loud equipment and report it.

noise-day-alert.title: Daily noise over limit
noise-day-alert.what: Noise over the last 24 hours averaged {noiseDayLevelDba} dBA, above NASA's {setting:noise.dayAlertAboveDba} dBA daily limit.
noise-day-alert.why: A daily noise dose this high can damage hearing [V2 6115].
noise-day-alert.do: Wear hearing protection now. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-energy-low-alert.title: Energy intake low yesterday
nutrition-energy-low-alert.what: Yesterday you logged {energyDayKcal} kcal, {energyDayPctOfEer}% of your estimated energy requirement ({eerKcal} kcal), below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.energyWatchBelowPct}–{setting:nutrition.energyWatchAbovePct}%.
nutrition-energy-low-alert.why: Eating less than the body needs leads to loss of body mass, mostly muscle and fat, which has been common in spaceflight.
nutrition-energy-low-alert.do: Eat full meals and add snacks today. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-energy-low-watch.title: Energy intake low yesterday
nutrition-energy-low-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {energyDayKcal} kcal, {energyDayPctOfEer}% of your estimated energy requirement ({eerKcal} kcal), below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.energyWatchBelowPct}–{setting:nutrition.energyWatchAbovePct}%.
nutrition-energy-low-watch.why: Eating less than the body needs leads to loss of body mass, mostly muscle and fat, which has been common in spaceflight.
nutrition-energy-low-watch.do: Eat full meals and add snacks today.

nutrition-energy-high-watch.title: Energy intake high yesterday
nutrition-energy-high-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {energyDayKcal} kcal, {energyDayPctOfEer}% of your estimated energy requirement ({eerKcal} kcal), above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.energyWatchBelowPct}–{setting:nutrition.energyWatchAbovePct}%.
nutrition-energy-high-watch.why: Eating well above your needs over many days leads to weight gain.

nutrition-energy-high-alert.title: Energy intake high yesterday
nutrition-energy-high-alert.what: Yesterday you logged {energyDayKcal} kcal, {energyDayPctOfEer}% of your estimated energy requirement ({eerKcal} kcal), above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.energyWatchBelowPct}–{setting:nutrition.energyWatchAbovePct}%.
nutrition-energy-high-alert.why: Eating well above your needs over many days leads to weight gain.
nutrition-energy-high-alert.do: Choose smaller portions today. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-protein-low-alert.title: Protein share low yesterday
nutrition-protein-low-alert.what: Yesterday {proteinDayPctOfKcal}% of your calories came from protein, below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.proteinWatchBelowPctKcal}–{setting:nutrition.proteinWatchAbovePctKcal}% of calories.
nutrition-protein-low-alert.why: Protein helps protect muscle, which shrinks in microgravity.
nutrition-protein-low-alert.do: Add protein-rich menu items today. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-protein-low-watch.title: Protein share low yesterday
nutrition-protein-low-watch.what: Yesterday {proteinDayPctOfKcal}% of your calories came from protein, below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.proteinWatchBelowPctKcal}–{setting:nutrition.proteinWatchAbovePctKcal}% of calories.
nutrition-protein-low-watch.why: Protein helps protect muscle, which shrinks in microgravity.

nutrition-protein-high-watch.title: Protein share high yesterday
nutrition-protein-high-watch.what: Yesterday {proteinDayPctOfKcal}% of your calories came from protein, above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.proteinWatchBelowPctKcal}–{setting:nutrition.proteinWatchAbovePctKcal}% of calories.
nutrition-protein-high-watch.why: Very high protein intake can increase calcium loss from bone.
nutrition-protein-high-watch.do: Balance today's meals with more vegetables and grains.

nutrition-protein-high-alert.title: Protein share high yesterday
nutrition-protein-high-alert.what: Yesterday {proteinDayPctOfKcal}% of your calories came from protein, above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.proteinWatchBelowPctKcal}–{setting:nutrition.proteinWatchAbovePctKcal}% of calories.
nutrition-protein-high-alert.why: Very high protein intake can increase calcium loss from bone.
nutrition-protein-high-alert.do: Balance today's meals with more vegetables and grains. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-calcium-low-alert.title: Calcium low yesterday
nutrition-calcium-low-alert.what: Yesterday you logged {calciumDayMg} mg of calcium, below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.calciumWatchBelowMg}–{setting:nutrition.calciumWatchAboveMg} mg.
nutrition-calcium-low-alert.why: Bones lose calcium in microgravity, and too little in the diet adds to the loss.
nutrition-calcium-low-alert.do: Add calcium-rich menu items today. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-calcium-low-watch.title: Calcium low yesterday
nutrition-calcium-low-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {calciumDayMg} mg of calcium, below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.calciumWatchBelowMg}–{setting:nutrition.calciumWatchAboveMg} mg.
nutrition-calcium-low-watch.why: Bones lose calcium in microgravity, and too little in the diet adds to the loss.

nutrition-calcium-high-watch.title: Calcium high yesterday
nutrition-calcium-high-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {calciumDayMg} mg of calcium, above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.calciumWatchBelowMg}–{setting:nutrition.calciumWatchAboveMg} mg.
nutrition-calcium-high-watch.why: Too much calcium raises the risk of kidney stones, which is already higher in spaceflight.

nutrition-calcium-high-alert.title: Calcium high yesterday
nutrition-calcium-high-alert.what: Yesterday you logged {calciumDayMg} mg of calcium, above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.calciumWatchBelowMg}–{setting:nutrition.calciumWatchAboveMg} mg.
nutrition-calcium-high-alert.why: Too much calcium raises the risk of kidney stones, which is already higher in spaceflight.
nutrition-calcium-high-alert.do: Choose fewer calcium-rich items today. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-vitaminD-low-alert.title: Vitamin D low yesterday
nutrition-vitaminD-low-alert.what: Yesterday you logged {vitaminDDayUg} µg of vitamin D, below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.vitaminDWatchBelowUg}–{setting:nutrition.vitaminDWatchAboveUg} µg.
nutrition-vitaminD-low-alert.why: Without sunlight, astronauts depend on food and supplements for the vitamin D their bones need.
nutrition-vitaminD-low-alert.do: Add vitamin D-rich menu items today, and ask the flight surgeon about supplements. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-vitaminD-low-watch.title: Vitamin D low yesterday
nutrition-vitaminD-low-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {vitaminDDayUg} µg of vitamin D, below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.vitaminDWatchBelowUg}–{setting:nutrition.vitaminDWatchAboveUg} µg.
nutrition-vitaminD-low-watch.why: Without sunlight, astronauts depend on food and supplements for the vitamin D their bones need.
nutrition-vitaminD-low-watch.do: Add vitamin D-rich menu items today, and ask the flight surgeon about supplements.

nutrition-vitaminD-high-watch.title: Vitamin D high yesterday
nutrition-vitaminD-high-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {vitaminDDayUg} µg of vitamin D, above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.vitaminDWatchBelowUg}–{setting:nutrition.vitaminDWatchAboveUg} µg.
nutrition-vitaminD-high-watch.why: Very high vitamin D intake over time can be harmful.
nutrition-vitaminD-high-watch.do: Choose fewer vitamin D-rich items today, and tell the flight surgeon if you take a supplement.

nutrition-sodium-low-alert.title: Sodium low yesterday
nutrition-sodium-low-alert.what: Yesterday you logged {sodiumDayMg} mg of sodium, below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.sodiumWatchBelowMg}–{setting:nutrition.sodiumWatchAboveMg} mg.
nutrition-sodium-low-alert.why: Too little sodium can upset the body's fluid and electrolyte balance.
nutrition-sodium-low-alert.do: Add a salted item to today's meals. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-sodium-low-watch.title: Sodium low yesterday
nutrition-sodium-low-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {sodiumDayMg} mg of sodium, below the daily target of {setting:nutrition.sodiumWatchBelowMg}–{setting:nutrition.sodiumWatchAboveMg} mg.
nutrition-sodium-low-watch.why: Too little sodium can upset the body's fluid and electrolyte balance.
nutrition-sodium-low-watch.do: Add a salted item to today's meals.

nutrition-sodium-high-watch.title: Sodium high yesterday
nutrition-sodium-high-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {sodiumDayMg} mg of sodium, above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.sodiumWatchBelowMg}–{setting:nutrition.sodiumWatchAboveMg} mg.
nutrition-sodium-high-watch.why: High sodium is linked to bone loss, kidney stones and high blood pressure.

nutrition-sodium-high-alert.title: Sodium high yesterday
nutrition-sodium-high-alert.what: Yesterday you logged {sodiumDayMg} mg of sodium, above the daily target of {setting:nutrition.sodiumWatchBelowMg}–{setting:nutrition.sodiumWatchAboveMg} mg.
nutrition-sodium-high-alert.why: High sodium is linked to bone loss, kidney stones and high blood pressure.
nutrition-sodium-high-alert.do: Choose lower-sodium items today. An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon.

nutrition-protein-minimum-watch.title: Protein below minimum yesterday
nutrition-protein-minimum-watch.what: Yesterday you logged {proteinDayG} g of protein, below your minimum of {proteinMinimumG} g ({setting:nutrition.proteinGPerKg} g per kg of body mass).
nutrition-protein-minimum-watch.why: Protein helps protect muscle, which shrinks in microgravity.

behavioral-health-watch.title: Possible behavioral health concern
behavioral-health-watch.what: Your mood check-ins over the last {setting:mind.windowDays} days averaged low ({moodAverage}), and your HRV is {hrvBelowBaselineSd} standard deviations below your baseline.
behavioral-health-watch.why: Isolation, confinement and disrupted sleep add up on long missions.
behavioral-health-watch.do: Protect your next sleep period and consider a private call with the flight surgeon or family.

behavioral-health-alert.title: Behavioral health concern
behavioral-health-alert.what: Your mood check-ins averaged low ({moodAverage}) and your stress check-ins high ({stressAverage}) over the last {setting:mind.windowDays} days, and your HRV is {hrvBelowBaselineSd} standard deviations below your baseline.
behavioral-health-alert.why: Isolation, confinement and disrupted sleep add up on long missions.
behavioral-health-alert.do: An alert has been sent to the flight surgeon. You can ask them for a private conference.
